question: Does adding the original bounded leveling directions to COM-first centering avoid the rear-hip stall observed in both translation-only variants?
input_scope: All 110 original R10AG loaded plans, with original-plan parity; 600 ideal updates from each of first and last loaded poses, steps 513 and 1108. Retain both outcomes.
change: During centering only, extend the 30 coupled-translation candidates with original negative, zero and positive level-blend rates, giving 90 candidates. Keep selection, model design margin, IK and motor bounds, and post-centering rise selection unchanged.
required_checks: Hull and selection controls from v1; explicit enumeration bound, qualified-support refusal and deterministic immutable input controls for v2; source bindings unchanged; reproduce every original loaded plan.
assumptions: Perfect torso/joint tracking, all contacts qualified, fixed torso-local COM, ideal rigid FK. No dynamics, friction, contact force or physical task prediction.
acceptance_boundary: Even a favorable mathematical result requires a distinct native controller implementation, interface/safety qualification, successful full-consumer synthetic reports and a fresh declared physical diagnostic. No population, launch or release authority is granted.
